title: dnd-5e-2024 feat stats (docs/rulesets.md#feats)
description: Stored inputs only. Derives `repeatable` for the facet. Cross-field rules are checks in checks.ts (docs/rulesets.md#consistency-checks).

category.description: The feat's category, printed under its name: "Origin Feat", "General Feat", "Fighting Style Feat", "Epic Boon Feat".

level.description: The prerequisite's minimum character level, printed first in it: "Level 4+".

prerequisite.description: The rest of the prerequisite, as printed: "Strength or Dexterity 13+", "Fighting Style Feature".

benefits.description: Titled benefits, printed after "You gain the following benefits." as bold-titled paragraphs.

text.description: The benefit of a feat without titled benefits.

repeatable.description: The "Repeatable" paragraph's text, printed last: "You can take this feat more than once."
